S1_native_transports.commutant: 12 sector projectors plus the link 11111 <-> 00000 and its adjoint
S1_native_transports.statement: every native transport has determinant one on the code; the scalars are the fifth roots of unity; they lie inside the hypercharge circle; the top-form link is invariant

S2_port_phases.intersection_with_U1_N: Z5 (scalars e^(i alpha) with e^(5 i alpha) = 1)

S3_seam_reflectors.det_exp(i theta S): exp(i theta tr S): the whole circle for continuous theta; at theta = pi an element of infinite order (tr S irrational), so the closure of its powers is the whole circle
S3_seam_reflectors.its_centre: one U(1) generated by Q = (s_t/3) n3 + (s_d/2) n2 = (tr S/5) N + ((s_d/2 - s_t/3)/5) 6Y
S3_seam_reflectors.note_on_GL: GL's M1b builds the seam state with A[a, b] in the place of A[b, a]; that state is not covariant under port rephasing and its weights differ from seam to seam (0.071 to 0.431). The covariant state is used here. With the covariant state the closure of the seam projectors alone has dimension 12 (GL: 13); together with the port phases it has dimension 13.
S3_seam_reflectors.statement: fractional seam reflectors with the port phases realize the whole U(1)_N on the code and give the top form the charge tr S per unit angle; the full reflectors of the public law, compressed to the code, are positive contractions with unitary part of determinant one

joint_test_2cos(3 omega_t + 2 omega_d).argument: a root of unity u has 2 Re(u) an algebraic integer, whose monic conjugate polynomial is integral

S4_walk_on_the_code.statement: in the level reading (levels = leading flux multiplets with their walk phases) the tick acts on the code with determinant exp(-i (3 omega_t + 2 omega_d)), an element of infinite order; in the pattern reading of CF-1 (T6 item 1) the patterns 11111 and 00000 are both parallel sections with phase 0

S5_algebra_with_toggle.generators: 12 port responses, the occupation number, the toggle of s2 and its images (s1, quadrature)
S5_algebra_with_toggle.structure: direct sum over n3 of the full matrix algebras of dimensions 4, 12, 12, 4 (double commutant)
S5_algebra_with_toggle.statement: the number of occupied vector levels is conserved by every operation of the program, the toggle included; the top-form link has amplitude zero at every order
